description: Phase 2 (2D): the single reviewable record for one gauntlet run — the verdict, the stage results, the external-tool evidence (LATTE/TRICERATOPS, which the verdict record has no slot for), a scores summary, provenance, input hashes, and a completeness checklist. Built by gauntlet/evidence.py:build_evidence_package.

artifacts.description: Paths/ids of evidence files behind this result.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the configuration the tool ran with.

detection_limit.description: Faintest signal this stage could have seen, same units as value.

execution_status.description: Execution outcome, separate from the scientific outcome: a crashed tool is 'error' with status 'unmeasured', never a scientific fail.

input_hashes.description: sha256 hashes of the inputs this result was computed from, keyed by input name.

metrics.description: Stage-specific numbers that do not fit the fixed evidence fields (e.g. TRICERATOPS FPP/NFPP — preserved, never reduced to a bare pass/fail).

policy_version.description: Version of the decision policy that produced this result's disposition (e.g. 'external_tools_v1') — the raw evidence is policy-free, so a policy-only edit re-derives the disposition without re-running the tool (P-4).

record_type.description: Record-type discriminator, present on standalone stage-result records.

schema_version.description: Provenance schema version of this record.

threshold.description: The pass bar in the same units as value. Null when the stage is a classification, not a thresholded measurement.

tool_version.description: Version of the tool that produced this result.

value.description: The measured quantity (e.g. fold depth %), in the same units as uncertainty/threshold.

waiver_code.description: Waiver reason code (F-5): the structural reason this stage may be waived, from the WAIVER_CODES map in gauntlet/stage_result.py (e.g. 'single_sector'). Attached by the producer; a waiver is valid only when the result carries a code.

waiver_reason.description: Per-target reason the stage was waived (F-5), stamped by apply_waivers. Present only on a waived stage.
